title: Impact of Truck Electrification on Air Pollution Disparities in the U.S. Nature Communications. 17, 468 (2026)
abstract: Electrifying heavy-duty trucks reduces on-road diesel emissions but shifts the burden of supplying energy to power-generation facilities. The combined effect of Inflation Reduction Act investments in grid decarbonization and truck electrification will alter the magnitude and distribution of air pollution burdens across the United States. These investments are intended to facilitate a just energy transition, with 40% of the benefits flowing to disadvantaged communities per the Justice40 Initiative. Here we evaluate the combined effects of Inflation Reduction Act grid decarbonization and truck electrification investments on a national scale to determine whether the air pollution benefits would meet this 40% goal for both disadvantaged communities and the most exposed racial–ethnic groups. We find that truck electrification and decarbonization reduce air-pollution-related premature mortality in disadvantaged communities. However, the relative disparity between disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged communities increases, suggesting that a disproportionate share of benefits accrue to non-disadvantaged communities. Whereas absolute disparity in grid emissions decreases over time for all racial–ethnic groups, relative disparity remains largely unchanged, with Black populations being the most exposed. Electrifying drayage corridors would result in comparatively large health benefits for disadvantaged communities, suggesting that increasing targeted electrification investments in short-haul routes near urban areas (for example, ports) could be promising.
abstract_zh: 重型卡车电动化减少了道路柴油排放，但将供能负担转移到了发电设施上。《通胀削减法案》中对电网脱碳和卡车电动化的投资相结合，将改变美国各地空气污染负担的规模与分布。这些投资旨在促进公正的能源转型，按照“Justice40”倡议，40%的收益应流向弱势社区。在此，我们在全国范围内评估《通胀削减法案》电网脱碳与卡车电动化投资的综合效应，以判断空气污染收益能否同时满足弱势社区和暴露程度最高的种族—族裔群体的这一40%目标。我们发现，卡车电动化和脱碳减少了弱势社区中与空气污染相关的过早死亡。然而，弱势社区与非弱势社区之间的相对差距有所扩大，表明收益中不成比例的份额流向了非弱势社区。尽管所有种族—族裔群体的电网排放绝对差距随时间下降，但相对差距基本保持不变，其中黑人群体暴露程度最高。对货运走廊进行电动化改造，将为弱势社区带来相对较大的健康收益，这表明加大对城市周边短途路线（例如港口）的针对性电动化投资可能大有可为。

title: Quantifying Heterogeneity in the Price Elasticity of Residential Natural Gas
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We exploit a spatial discontinuity in two natural gas utilities’ service territories—combined with variation in their block-rate pricing structure and a difference in how prima facie determined wholesale prices are differentially passed through to consumers—to identify average, seasonal, and income-specific own-price elasticities of residential natural gas demand. We estimate an average elasticity ranging from 0.15 to 0.19 depending on the measure of price used. We further estimate that this elasticity varies substantially across seasons, income groups, and their interaction. We find no significant difference in consumers’ responses to average versus marginal prices.
abstract_zh: 我们利用两家天然气公司服务区域的空间断点，并结合其分段累进定价结构的差异，以及表面上确定的批发价格向消费者传导方式的差异，来识别居民天然气需求的平均自价格弹性、季节性自价格弹性和分收入组自价格弹性。根据所采用的价格衡量指标，我们估计的平均弹性在0.15至0.19之间。我们进一步估计，该弹性在不同季节、收入群体及其交互项之间存在显著差异。我们发现，消费者对平均价格与边际价格的反应没有显著差异。

title: The Spatiotemporal Pattern of Surface Ozone and Its Impact on Agricultural Productivity in China
abstract: The slowing of agricultural productivity growth globally over the past two decades has brought a new urgency to detect its drivers and potential solutions. We show that air pollution, particularly surface ozone (O3), is strongly associated with declining agricultural total factor productivity (TFP) in China. We employ machine learning algorithms to generate estimates of high-resolution surface O3 concentrations from 2002 to 2019. Results indicate that China's O3 pollution has intensified over this 18-year period. We coupled these O3 estimates with a statistical model to show that rising O3 pollution during nonwinter seasons has reduced agricultural TFP by 18% over the 2002–2015 period. Agricultural TFP is projected to increase by 60% if surface O3 concentrations were reduced to meet the WHO air quality standards. This productivity gain has the potential to counter expected productivity losses from 2°C warming.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间全球农业生产率增长放缓，使得探究其驱动因素及潜在解决方案变得更为紧迫。我们发现，空气污染，尤其是地面臭氧（O3），与中国农业全要素生产率（TFP）的下降高度相关。我们运用机器学习算法，生成了2002年至2019年高分辨率的地面O3浓度估计值。结果表明，在这18年间，中国的O3污染有所加剧。我们将这些O3估计值与一个统计模型相结合，发现在2002年至2015年间，非冬季臭氧污染的上升使农业全要素生产率降低了18%。如果将地面O3浓度降至满足WHO空气质量标准的水平，农业全要素生产率预计将提高60%。这一生产率的增长有可能抵消2°C变暖所带来的预期生产率损失。

title: The visual effect of wind turbines on property values is small and diminishing in space and time
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
Renewable power generation is the key to decarbonizing the electricity system. Wind power is the fastest-growing renewable source of electricity in the United States. However, expanding wind capacity often faces local opposition, partly due to a perceived visual disamenity from large wind turbines. Here, we provide a US-wide assessment of the externality costs of wind power generation through the visibility impact on property values. To this end, we create a database on wind turbine visibility, combining information on the site and height of each utility-scale turbine having fed power into the U.S. grid, with a high-resolution elevation map to account for the underlying topography of the landscape. Building on hedonic valuation theory, we statistically estimate the impact of wind turbine visibility on home values, informed by data from the majority of home sales in the United States since 1997. We find that on average, wind turbine visibility negatively affects home values in an economically and statistically significant way in close proximity (
5 miles/8 km). However, the effect diminishes over time and in distance and is indistinguishable from zero for larger distances and toward the end of our sample.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源发电是电力系统脱碳的关键。风电是美国增长最快的可再生电力来源。然而，风电装机容量的扩张往往面临当地的反对，部分原因在于大型风力发电机带来的视觉负效用。在此，我们通过对房产价值的视觉影响，对风力发电的外部成本进行了全美范围的评估。为此，我们构建了风机可见性数据库，将每台已向美国电网供电的公用事业规模风机的位置和高度信息，与高分辨率高程图相结合，以反映景观的地形条件。基于享乐估价理论，我们利用1997年以来美国大部分房屋销售的数据，统计估计了风机可见性对房屋价值的影响。我们发现，平均而言，在近距离范围内（不超过5英里/8公里），风机可见性对房屋价值产生了经济上和统计上均显著的负面影响。然而，这一影响会随时间和距离的推移而减弱；在更远的距离上，以及在样本期末，该影响与零没有显著差异。

Climate Adaptive Response Estimation: Short And Long Run Impacts Of Climate Change On Residential Electricity and Natural Gas Consumption. 2022
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper proposes a simple two-step estimation method (Climate Adaptive Response Estimation - CARE) to estimate sectoral climate damage functions, which account for long-run adaptation. The paper applies this method in the context of residential electricity and natural gas demand for the world’s fifth largest economy — California. The advantage of the proposed method is that it only requires detailed information on intensive margin behavior, yet does not require explicit knowledge of the extensive margin response (e.g., technology adoption). Using almost two billion energy bills, we estimate spatially highly disaggregated intensive margin temperature response functions using daily variation in weather. In a second step, we explain variation in the slopes of the dose response functions across space as a function of summer climate. Using 18 climate models, we simulate future demand by letting households vary consumption along the intensive and extensive margins. We show that failing to account for extensive margin adjustment in electricity demand leads to a significant underestimate of the future impacts on electricity consumption. We further show that reductions in natural gas demand more than offset any climate-driven increases in electricity consumption in this context.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种简便的两步估计方法（气候适应性响应估计，CARE），用以估计考虑长期适应的分部门气候损害函数。本文将该方法应用于世界第五大经济体——加利福尼亚州的居民电力和天然气需求。该方法的优势在于，它只需要关于集约边际行为的详细信息，而无需明确了解扩展边际的响应（例如技术采用）。利用近二十亿份能源账单，我们借助天气的日度变化，估计了空间高度细化的集约边际温度响应函数。在第二步中，我们将剂量-响应函数斜率在空间上的差异，解释为夏季气候的函数。利用18个气候模式，我们通过让家庭沿集约边际和扩展边际调整消费，模拟了未来的需求。我们表明，若未考虑电力需求中的扩展边际调整，将显著低估未来对电力消费的影响。我们进一步表明，在此背景下，天然气需求的减少足以抵消任何由气候驱动的电力消费增长。

title: Looking Back at Fifty Years of the Clean Air Act
Energy consumption and charging load profiles from long-haul truck electrification in the United States
abstract:
The urgent need to decarbonize the transportation sector combined with falling battery prices has spurred industry and policy interest in long-haul truck electrification. The charging behavior and resulting loads from electrified long-haul freight trucks are crucial for the smooth operation of the electric grid and have far-reaching environmental impacts (e.g., greenhouse gas and other air pollutant emissions). However, the aggregate energy impact of a fleetwide shift to electrified long-haul freight trucking has not been explored. This study combines electric truck design scenarios, bottom-up truck weight modeling, vehicle energy modeling, large-scale truck traffic data, and simulation of likely operation and charging behaviors to estimate end-use energy consumption and location-specific hourly charging loads for a national fleet of long-haul electric trucks. Relative to a fleet of future diesel trucks, electrification would reduce direct end-use energy consumption by 0.9 × 10
18
J (0.9 quadrillion BTU), but electrification might increase life cycle energy consumption depending on the electricity source. The electricity required to charge long-haul electric trucks is equivalent to five percent of annual electricity consumption in the United States (US). The simulated truck charging loads peak during the day across the US grid regions, but the charging peaks’ exact timing is sensitive to when trucks are dispatched for operation. The load shapes suggest that electric trucks’ charging loads can coincide with peaks in solar power generation, and planning could enable on- or off-site integration between truck charging stations and renewable electricity generation.
abstract_zh: 在交通部门实现脱碳的迫切需要，加上电池价格的下降，推动了业界和政策界对长途卡车电动化的兴趣。电动长途货运卡车的充电行为及由此产生的负荷，对电网的平稳运行至关重要，并会带来深远的环境影响（例如温室气体和其他大气污染物排放）。然而，全车队向电动长途货运转型的总体能源影响尚未得到研究。本研究综合了电动卡车设计情景、自下而上的卡车重量建模、车辆能耗建模、大规模卡车交通数据，以及对可能运营与充电行为的模拟，以估计全国电动长途卡车车队的终端能源消费以及分地点的逐时充电负荷。与未来柴油卡车车队相比，电动化将使直接终端能源消费减少0.9×10^18焦耳（0.9千万亿英热单位），但全生命周期能源消费是否增加则取决于电力来源。为长途电动卡车充电所需的电量，相当于美国年用电量的5%。在美国各电网区域，模拟的卡车充电负荷在白天达到峰值，但峰值的确切时间对卡车的调度时间十分敏感。负荷曲线表明，电动卡车的充电负荷可能与太阳能发电的高峰重合，而科学规划可以使卡车充电站与可再生电力生产在场内或场外实现整合。

title: Health and Climate Impacts from Long-Haul Truck Electrification
abstract: Long-haul truck electrification has attracted nascent policy support, but the potential health and climate impacts remain uncertain. Here, we developed an integrated assessment approach with high spatial-temporal (km and hourly) resolution to characterize the causal chain from truck operation to charging loads, electricity grid response, changes in emissions and atmospheric concentrations, and the resulting health and climate impacts across the United States. Compared to future diesel trucks, electrified trucking’s net health benefits are concentrated only along the West Coast with a business-as-usual electricity grid. However, with an 80%-renewable electricity grid, most regions would experience net health benefits, and the economic value of avoided climate and health damages exceeds $5 billion annually, an 80% reduction relative to future diesel trucks. Electric trucks with larger batteries may increase health and climate impacts due to additional trips needed to compensate for the payload penalty, but a 2× improvement in the battery specific energy (to ∼320 Wh/kg) could eliminate the additional trips.
abstract_zh: 长途卡车电动化已开始获得政策支持，但其对健康和气候的潜在影响仍不确定。在此，我们开发了一种具有高时空分辨率（公里级和逐时）的综合评估方法，用以刻画从卡车运营到充电负荷、电网响应、排放与大气浓度变化，再到美国境内由此产生的健康与气候影响的因果链条。与未来柴油卡车相比，在照常运营（business-as-usual）的电网情景下，电动卡车运输的净健康收益仅集中于西海岸。然而，在可再生能源占比达80%的电网情景下，大多数地区将获得净健康收益，且避免的气候和健康损害的经济价值每年超过50亿美元，相对于未来柴油卡车减少了80%。由于需要额外行程来弥补载重损失，配备更大电池的电动卡车可能会增加健康和气候影响；但若电池比能量提高2倍（达到约320 Wh/kg），则可消除这些额外行程。

Quantifying Economic Damages From Climate Change
abstract: Climate scientists have spent billions of dollars and eons of supercomputer time studying how increased concentrations of greenhouse gases and changes in the reflectivity of the earth’s surface affect dimensions of the climate system relevant to human society: surface temperature, precipitation, humidity, and sea levels. Recent incarnations of physical climate models have become sophisticated enough to be able to simulate intensities and frequencies of some extreme events, like tropical storms, under different warming scenarios. In a stark juxtaposition, the efforts involved in and the public resources targeted at understanding how these physical changes translate into economic impacts are disproportionately smaller, with most of the major models being developed and maintained with little to no public funding support. The goal of this paper is first to shed light on how (mostly) economists have gone about calculating the “social cost of carbon” for regulatory purposes and to provide an overview of the past and currently used estimates. In the second part, I will focus on where empirical economists may have the highest value added in this enterprise: specifically, the calibration and estimation of economic damage functions, which map weather patterns transformed by climate change into economic benefits and damages. A broad variety of econometric methods have recently been used to parameterize the dose (climate) response (economic outcome) functions. The paper seeks to provide an accessible and comprehensive overview of how economists think about parameterizing damage functions and quantifying the economic damages of climate change.
abstract_zh: 气候科学家已投入数十亿美元和无数超级计算机机时，研究温室气体浓度的增加以及地球表面反照率的变化，如何影响与人类社会相关的气候系统维度：地表温度、降水、湿度和海平面。近期的物理气候模式已足够复杂，能够模拟不同变暖情景下某些极端事件（如热带风暴）的强度和频率。形成鲜明对比的是，用于理解这些物理变化如何转化为经济影响的努力和公共资源投入则要小得多，大多数主要模型的开发与维护几乎得不到公共资金支持。本文的目标，首先是阐明（主要由经济学家）如何为规制目的计算“碳的社会成本”，并概述过去及当前采用的估计值。在第二部分，我将聚焦于实证经济学家在这一工作中可能提供最大增量价值的领域：具体而言，是校准和估计经济损害函数，该函数将经气候变化转化的天气模式映射为经济收益和损失。近期已有多种计量经济学方法被用于参数化剂量（气候）-响应（经济结果）函数。本文力求以通俗且全面的方式，概述经济学家如何思考损害函数的参数化问题，以及如何量化气候变化的经济损害。

title: Regional Crop Diversity and Weather Shocks in India
abstract: Agriculture in both the developing and developed country context is highly sensitive to weather shocks. The intensity of these shocks is likely to increase under climate change, leading to an ongoing debate regarding the ability of farmers to insulate yields and income against accelerating environmental extremes. We study crop diversity as an avenue for increased resilience. Diversity in agricultural systems has been suggested in the agroecology and environmental economics literatures as a powerful means of on-farm insurance, both through physical and market-based channels. However, large-scale empirical evidence of its effectiveness is lacking, and crop diversity is largely absent from the empirical climate impacts literature. We examine the insurance benefits of crop diversity in the context of India at the height of the Green Revolution, a period of rapid change in agricultural diversification due to the increased penetration of a small set of high-yielding variety crops. Building on a basic empirical model from the climate impacts literature, we show that areas with higher crop diversity of planted area display measurably more drought resilience, both in terms of gross and net revenues. We decompose this aggregate result to show that diversification has implications for farmer welfare both through physical (yield) and market (price) channels.
abstract_zh: 无论在发展中国家还是发达国家，农业都对天气冲击高度敏感。在气候变化之下，这些冲击的强度很可能增加，由此引发了关于农民能否保障产量和收入以抵御日益加剧的环境极端事件的持续争论。我们以作物多样性作为提高韧性的途径进行研究。农业生态学和环境经济学文献提出，农业系统中的多样性可以通过实物渠道和市场渠道，成为一种强有力的农场内保险手段。然而，关于其有效性的大规模实证证据仍然缺乏，且作物多样性在气候影响的实证文献中基本缺席。我们以印度绿色革命高峰期为背景，考察作物多样性的保险效益。在此期间，少数高产品种的推广导致农业多样化快速变化。在气候影响文献中一个基本实证模型的基础上，我们表明，种植面积作物多样性较高的地区，在毛收入和净收入两方面均表现出可测度的更强抗旱能力。我们对这一总体结果进行了分解，表明多样化既通过实物（产量）渠道，也通过市场（价格）渠道，对农民福利产生影响。

title: The Farmer's Climate Change Adaptation Challenge in Least Developed Countries
abstract: Climate change poses many new risks to people in the developing world. Unlike in standard choice under uncertainty problems, the risks from climate change are both ambiguous and non-stationary. We examine climate projections concerning what scenarios are most likely to unfold. We explore how individual farmers in the developing world are likely to respond to these challenges. This analysis points out data gaps and valuable future research paths. Urbanization offers one possible adaptation channel. We explore the opportunities and challenges posed by climate change induced accelerated Least Developed Country (LDC) urbanization.
abstract_zh: 气候变化给发展中国家的人民带来了许多新的风险。与标准的不确定性下的选择问题不同，气候变化的风险既是模糊的，也是非平稳的。我们考察了关于哪些情景最有可能出现的气候预测。我们探讨了发展中国家的个体农民可能如何应对这些挑战。这一分析指出了数据缺口和有价值的未来研究方向。城市化是一条可能的适应途径。我们探讨了气候变化所引发的最不发达国家（LDC）加速城市化所带来的机遇与挑战。

title: Climate change is projected to have severe impacts on the frequency and intensity of peak electricity demand across the United States
venue: Proceedings of the National Academies of Sciences
abstract: The existing empirical literature on the impacts of climate change on the electricity sector has focused on changing electricity consumption patterns. In this paper, we show that incorporating impacts on the frequency and intensity of peak load consumption during hot days implies sizable required investments in peak generating capacity (or major advances in storage technology or the structure of electricity prices), which results in substantially larger impacts than those from just changes in overall consumption.
abstract_zh: 现有关于气候变化对电力部门影响的实证文献，主要关注电力消费模式的变化。在本文中，我们表明，若将炎热天气下用电高峰负荷的频率和强度的影响纳入考虑，则意味着需要在高峰发电容量上进行大量投资（或在储能技术或电价结构上取得重大突破），其结果所带来的影响将远大于仅考虑总体消费变化的影响。

title: North-South polarization of European electricity consumption under future warming
venue: Proceedings of the National Academies of Sciences

title: Measuring the Welfare Losses from Urban Water Supply Disruptions
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The paper evaluates welfare losses from urban water supply disruptions for a sample of 53 urban water utilities in California collectively providing service to over 20 million customers. The analysis accounts for the fact that most water utilities engage in a form of average cost pricing where volumetric rates are used to finance fixed expenses. We estimate utility-specific price elasticities for use in the welfare analysis, which are derived from a demand estimation based on a panel data set of 37 California water utilities. Welfare losses for an annual disruption range from an average of $1,458 per acre-foot of shortage for a 10% supply disruption to an average of $3,426 per acre-foot of shortage for a 30% supply disruption. The results indicate a household-level willingness to pay to avoid an annual disruption of approximately $60–$600 depending on the shortage size and location.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了加利福尼亚州53家城市供水公用事业因城市供水中断而造成的福利损失，这些公用事业合计为超过2,000万用户提供服务。分析考虑了大多数供水公用事业采用的一种平均成本定价形式，即以按量计费的费率来为固定费用融资。我们为福利分析估计了各公用事业特定的价格弹性，这些弹性来自基于37家加利福尼亚州供水公用事业面板数据集的需求估计。年度供水中断造成的福利损失，在供水缺口为10%时，平均为每英亩-英尺短缺量1,458美元；在供水缺口为30%时，平均为每英亩-英尺短缺量3,426美元。结果表明，根据短缺规模和地点的不同，家庭为避免年度供水中断所愿意支付的金额约为60至600美元。

title: The Decomposition and Dynamics of Industrial Carbon Dioxide Emissions for 287 Chinese Cities
abstract: 85% of China's GHG emissions are attributed to urban economic activities, and this share is expected to rise given China's fast urbanization process. This paper provides estimates of city‐level industrial CO2 emissions and their growth rates for all 287 Chinese prefecture‐level and above cities during the years 1998–2009. We decompose the CO2 emission changes into scale, composition and technique effects. The decomposition results show that these three effects differ significantly across the three tiers of cities in China. The scale effect contributes to rising CO2 emissions, while the technique effect leads to declining CO2 emissions in all cities. The composition effect leads to increasing CO2 emissions in the third‐tier cities, while it reduces CO2 emissions in the first and second‐tier cities, due to the relocation of energy‐intensive industries from the latter to the former type of cities. Based on these decomposition results, we identify the separate channels through which the inflow of FDI and the environmental regulations affect city‐level CO2 emissions. The decomposition framework in our paper can help policy makers and scholars to better understand Chinese cities’ trade‐offs between economic growth and environmental goals.
abstract_zh: 中国温室气体排放的85%归因于城市经济活动，鉴于中国快速的城市化进程，这一比例预计还将上升。本文估计了1998年至2009年间中国全部287个地级及以上城市的城市层面工业二氧化碳排放量及其增长率。我们将二氧化碳排放变化分解为规模效应、结构效应和技术效应。分解结果表明，这三种效应在中国三个层级的城市之间存在显著差异。规模效应促使二氧化碳排放上升，而技术效应使所有城市的二氧化碳排放下降。结构效应在三线城市中导致二氧化碳排放增加，而在一线和二线城市中则使其减少，原因在于能源密集型产业从后者向前者转移。基于这些分解结果，我们识别了外商直接投资（FDI）流入和环境规制影响城市层面二氧化碳排放的各自渠道。本文的分解框架有助于政策制定者和学者更好地理解中国城市在经济增长与环境目标之间的权衡。

title: China’s Carbon Emissions from fossil fuels and market based opportunities for control
abstract: In this article, we first review the history of carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from the combustion of fossil fuels for the People’s Republic of China (China). As Chinese regulators have announced efforts to directly regulate CO2 emissions, we review the history of institutions charged with climate regulation in China. Next we review China’s existing market-based approaches to emission control in the form of the world’s largest effluent fee system for air and water pollutants as well as seven pilot carbon markets. We conclude with a discussion of the issues and challenges ahead in adopting market-based instruments to regulate CO2 emissions in China.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们首先回顾了中华人民共和国（中国）化石燃料燃烧所产生的二氧化碳（CO2）排放的历史。鉴于中国监管部门已宣布直接监管CO2排放的努力，我们回顾了中国负责气候监管的机构的发展历程。接下来，我们回顾了中国现有的基于市场的排放控制手段，包括世界上规模最大的大气和水污染物排污费制度，以及七个试点碳市场。最后，我们讨论了在中国采用基于市场的工具来监管CO2排放所面临的问题与挑战。

title: Linking local impacts to changes in climate - a guide to attribution
US power plant sites at risk of future sea-level rise
abstract: Unmitigated greenhouse gas emissions may increase global mean sea-level by about 1 meter during this century. Such elevation of the mean sea-level enhances the risk of flooding of coastal areas. We compute the power capacity that is currently out-of-reach of a 100-year coastal flooding but will be exposed to such a flood by the end of the century for different US states, if no adaptation measures are taken. The additional exposed capacity varies strongly among states. For Delaware it is 80% of the mean generated power load. For New York this number is 63% and for Florida 43%. The capacity that needs additional protection compared to today increases by more than 250% for Texas, 90% for Florida and 70% for New York. Current development in power plant building points towards a reduced future exposure to sea-level rise: proposed and planned power plants are less exposed than those which are currently operating. However, power plants that have been retired or canceled were less exposed than those operating at present. If sea-level rise is properly accounted for in future planning, an adaptation to sea-level rise may be costly but possible.
abstract_zh: 若不加以缓解，温室气体排放可能使本世纪全球平均海平面上升约1米。平均海平面的抬升会增加沿海地区的洪水风险。在没有任何适应措施的情况下，我们计算了美国各州目前处于百年一遇沿海洪水影响范围之外、但到本世纪末将暴露于此类洪水之中的发电容量。额外暴露的容量在各州之间差异很大。特拉华州的这一数字为平均发电负荷的80%，纽约州为63%，佛罗里达州为43%。与当前相比，需要额外保护的容量在得克萨斯州增加了250%以上，在佛罗里达州增加了90%，在纽约州增加了70%。当前的发电厂建设趋势指向未来受海平面上升影响的降低：拟建和规划中的发电厂比目前运营的发电厂暴露程度更低。然而，已退役或已取消的发电厂，其暴露程度低于目前运营的发电厂。如果在未来规划中妥善考虑海平面上升，对海平面上升的适应可能成本高昂，但是可行的。

title: Cooling China: The Weather Dependence of Air Conditioner Adoption
abstract: One of the major adaptation mechanisms to climate change is increased demand for cooling via the air conditioning of indoor environments. China's demand for air conditioners has displayed explosive growth since 1995. This paper provides estimates of the income and short run weather sensitivity of air conditioner adoption across urban areas for 29 Chinese provincial entities. We show that the adoption decision displays significant income and weather sensitivity in the short run, with adoption being higher the year following a hot summer. © 2014 Copyright 2014 by Koninklijke Brill NV, Leiden, The Netherlands.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化的一种主要适应机制，是通过室内环境空调增加对制冷的需求。自1995年以来，中国的空调需求呈现爆发式增长。本文估计了中国29个省级行政单位城市地区空调采用的收入弹性及短期天气敏感性。我们发现，空调采用决策在短期内表现出显著的收入敏感性和天气敏感性，在炎热夏季之后的一年，空调采用率更高。© 2014 Copyright 2014 by Koninklijke Brill NV, Leiden, The Netherlands.

title: Detection and attribution of observed impacts
authors: Maria Assunção Faus da Silva Dias

title: Empirical Studies on Agricultural Impacts and Adaptation
Land Markets and the Value of Water: Hedonic Analysis Using Repeat Sales of Farmland
abstract: The lack of robust water markets makes it difficult to value irrigation water. Because water rights are appurtenant to land, it is possible to infer the value of water from observed differences in the market price of land. We use panel data on repeat farmland sales in California's San Joaquin Valley to estimate a hedonic regression equation with parcel fixed effects. This controls for sources of omitted variables bias and allows us to recover the value of irrigation water to landowners in our sample. We show that a more traditional cross‐sectional regression results in an artificially low value of irrigation water.
abstract_zh: 缺乏稳健的水市场，使得灌溉用水的价值难以估量。由于水权附属于土地，我们可以从观察到的土地市场价格差异中推断水的价值。我们利用加利福尼亚州圣华金谷（San Joaquin Valley）农田重复销售的面板数据，估计了包含地块固定效应的享乐回归方程。这控制了遗漏变量偏误的来源，并使我们能够还原样本中土地所有者对灌溉用水的价值。我们表明，更为传统的截面回归会得出人为偏低的灌溉用水价值。

title: Measuring Climatic Impacts on Energy Expenditures: A Review of the Empirical Literature
On the Attribution of a Single Event to Climate Change
abstract: There is growing interest in assessing the role of climate change in observed extreme weather events. Recent work in this area has focused on estimating a measure called attributable risk. A statistical formulation of this problem is described and used to construct a confidence interval for attributable risk. The resulting confidence is shown to be surprisingly wide even in the case where the event of interest is unprecedented in the historical record.
abstract_zh: 人们对于评估气候变化在已观测到的极端天气事件中所起的作用，兴趣日益浓厚。该领域的近期研究聚焦于估计一种称为归因风险（attributable risk）的指标。本文描述了该问题的统计表述，并用其构造了归因风险的置信区间。结果表明，即使在所关注事件在历史记录中前所未有的情况下，所得置信区间也出人意料地宽。

title: Pounds That Kill: The External Costs of Vehicle Weight
abstract: Heavier vehicles are safer for their own occupants but more hazardous for the occupants of other vehicles. In this paper we estimate the increased probability of fatalities from being hit by a heavier vehicle in a collision. We show that, controlling for own-vehicle weight, being hit by a vehicle that is 1,000 pounds heavier results in a 47% increase in the baseline fatality probability. Estimation results further suggest that the fatality risk is even higher if the striking vehicle is a light truck (SUV, pickup truck, or minivan).We calculate that the value of the external risk generated by the gain in fleet weight since 1989 is approximately 27 cents per gallon of gasoline. We further calculate that the total fatality externality is roughly equivalent to a gas tax of $1.08 per gallon. We consider two policy options for internalizing this external cost: a gas tax and an optimal weight varying mileage tax. Comparing these options, we find that the cost is similar for most vehicles.
abstract_zh: 较重的车辆对其自身乘员更安全，但对其他车辆的乘员则更具危险性。本文估计了在碰撞中被较重车辆撞击所导致的死亡概率上升。我们表明，在控制本车重量的情况下，被重1,000磅的车辆撞击，会使基准死亡概率增加47%。估计结果进一步表明，若撞击车辆为轻型卡车（SUV、皮卡或小型货车），死亡风险则更高。我们计算出，自1989年以来车队重量的增加所产生的外部风险价值，约为每加仑汽油27美分。我们还计算出，全部死亡外部性大致相当于每加仑汽油1.08美元的燃油税。我们考虑了两种将这一外部成本内部化的政策选项：汽油税，以及随重量变化的最优里程税。比较这两种选项，我们发现对于大多数车辆而言，其成本是相近的。

title: Powering Up China: Income Distributions and Residential Electricity Consumption
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Current forecasts suggest that the vast majority of growth in energy demand will come from the developing world, and that China will play a major part in that growth. This paper presents evidence suggesting that the shape of the income distribution, which is typically omitted from forecasting models, plays a major role in driving household acquisition of energy-using durable goods in rural China. We use province-level data for rural households to show that the share of the population living above the poverty line is an important determinant of household appliance holdings even controlling for average household income.
abstract_zh: 目前的预测表明，能源需求的绝大部分增长将来自发展中国家，而中国将在这一增长中扮演主要角色。本文提供的证据表明，收入分布的形态——通常被预测模型所忽略——在驱动中国农村家庭购置耗能耐用品方面发挥着重要作用。我们利用省级农村家庭数据表明，即便控制了家庭平均收入，生活在贫困线以上的人口比例仍是家庭电器持有量的重要决定因素。

title: Specification and Estimation of the Transfer Function in Dendroclimatological Reconstructions
The challenge to detect and attribute effects of climate change on human and natural systems
abstract: Anthropogenic climate change has triggered impacts on natural and human systems world-wide, yet the formal scientific method of detection and attribution has been only insufficiently described. Detection and attribution of impacts of climate change is a fundamentally cross-disciplinary issue, involving concepts, terms, and standards spanning the varied requirements of the various disciplines. Key problems for current assessments include the limited availability of long-term observations, the limited knowledge on processes and mechanisms involved in changing environmental systems, and the widely different concepts applied in the scientific literature. In order to facilitate current and future assessments, this paper describes the current conceptual framework of the field and outlines a number of conceptual challenges. Based on this, it proposes workable cross-disciplinary definitions, concepts, and standards. The paper is specifically intended to serve as a baseline for continued development of a consistent cross-disciplinary framework that will facilitate integrated assessment of the detection and attribution of climate change impacts.
abstract_zh: 人为气候变化已在全球范围内对自然和人类系统产生了影响，然而，气候变化探测与归因（detection and attribution）的正式科学方法尚未得到充分阐述。气候变化影响的探测与归因从根本上说是一个跨学科问题，涉及概念、术语和标准，需要满足各学科的多样化要求。当前评估面临的关键问题包括：长期观测数据的可获得性有限；对环境系统变化所涉过程和机制的认识有限；以及科学文献中所采用的概念差异巨大。为便于当前和未来的评估，本文阐述了该领域当前的概念框架，并概述了若干概念上的挑战。在此基础上，本文提出了可行的跨学科定义、概念和标准。本文旨在作为持续发展统一跨学科框架的基准，以促进对气候变化影响的探测与归因进行综合评估。

title: Using Weather Data and Climate Model Output in Economic Analyses of Climate Change
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Economists are increasingly using weather data and climate model output in analyses of the economic impacts of climate change. This article introduces weather data sets and climate models that are frequently used, discusses the most common mistakes economists make in using these products, and identifies ways to avoid these pitfalls. We first provide an introduction to weather data, including a summary of the types of data sets available, and then we discuss five common pitfalls that empirical researchers should be aware of when using historical weather data as explanatory variables in econometric applications. We then provide a brief overview of climate models and discuss two common and significant errors often made by economists when climate model output is used to simulate the future impacts of climate change on an economic outcome of interest.
abstract_zh: 经济学家在分析气候变化的经济影响时，越来越多地使用天气数据和气候模式输出。本文介绍了常用的天气数据集和气候模式，讨论了经济学家在使用这些产品时最常犯的错误，并提出了规避这些陷阱的方法。我们首先介绍天气数据，包括对可用数据集类型的概述，然后讨论实证研究者在将历史天气数据作为计量经济学应用中的解释变量时应当注意的五个常见陷阱。随后，我们简要概述气候模式，并讨论经济学家在使用气候模式输出模拟气候变化对其关注的经济结果的未来影响时，常犯的两类重要错误。

title: Climate change, the monsoon, and rice yield in India
Farm Acreage Shocks and Food Prices: An SVAR Approach to Understanding the Impacts of Biofuels
abstract: The last ten years have seen tremendous expansion in biofuels production, particularly in corn ethanol in the United States, at the same time that commodity prices (e.g., corn) have experienced significant spikes. While supporters claim that biofuels are renewable and carbon-friendly, concerns have been raised about their impacts on land use and food prices. This paper analyzes how U.S. crop prices have responded to shocks in acreage supply; these shocks can be thought of as a shock to the residual supply of corn for food. Using a structural vector auto-regression framework, we examine shocks to a crop's own acreage and to total cropland. This allows us to estimate the effect of dedicating cropland or non-crop farmlands to biofuels feedstock production. A negative shock in own acreage leads to an increase in price for soybeans and corn. Our calculations show that increased corn ethanol production during the boom production year 2006/2007 explains approximately 27% of the experienced corn price rise.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，生物燃料产量经历了巨大扩张，尤其是美国的玉米乙醇，与此同时，玉米等大宗商品价格出现了显著的飙升。尽管支持者声称生物燃料是可再生且有利于减碳的，但人们对其对土地利用和粮食价格的影响表示担忧。本文分析了美国作物价格如何对耕地供给冲击作出反应；这些冲击可以被理解为用于食品的玉米剩余供给的冲击。借助结构向量自回归框架，我们考察了某一作物自身播种面积以及总耕地面积的冲击。这使我们能够估计将耕地或非耕地用于生物燃料原料生产的影响。自身播种面积的负向冲击，会导致大豆和玉米价格上涨。我们的计算表明，2006/2007年生物燃料繁荣期玉米乙醇产量的增加，解释了所观察到的玉米价格上涨中约27%的部分。

title: Forecasting the Path of US CO2 Emissions Using State-Level Information
abstract: We compare the most common reduced-form models used for emissions forecasting, point out shortcomings, and suggest improvements. Using a U.S. state-level panel data set of CO2 emissions, we test the performance of existing models against a large universe of potential reduced-form models. We find that leading models in the literature, as well as models selected based on an emissions per capita loss measure or different in-sample selection criteria, perform significantly worse compared to the best model chosen based directly on the out-of-sample loss measure defined over aggregate emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了用于排放预测的最常见简约式模型，指出其缺陷，并提出改进建议。利用美国州级CO2排放面板数据集，我们将现有模型的表现与大量潜在简约式模型进行了对比检验。我们发现，文献中的主流模型，以及基于人均排放损失指标或不同样本内选择准则选出的模型，其表现都明显差于直接依据总量排放的样本外损失指标选出的最优模型。

title: The impacts of State Level Building Codes on Residential Electricity Consumption
Unobserved time effects confound the identification of climate change impacts
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
A recent study by Feng et al. [Feng S, Krueger A, Oppenheimer M (2010)
Proc Natl Acad Sci USA
107:14257–14262] in PNAS reported statistical evidence of a weather-driven causal effect of crop yields on human migration from Mexico to the United States. We show that this conclusion is based on a different statistical model than the one stated in the paper. When we correct for this mistake, there is no evidence of a causal link.
abstract_zh: Feng等人（Feng S, Krueger A, Oppenheimer M，2010，Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 107:14257–14262）近期发表于PNAS的一项研究，报告了天气驱动的作物产量对墨西哥向美国移民具有因果效应的统计证据。我们表明，该结论基于一个与论文所述模型不同的统计模型。当我们纠正这一错误后，并未发现存在因果联系的证据。

title: Classification, Detection and Consequences of Data Error: Evidence from the Human Development Index
Clearing the Air? The Effects of Gasoline Content Regulation on Air Quality
abstract: This paper examines whether US gasoline content regulations, which impose substantial costs on consumers, have successfully reduced ozone pollution. We take advantage of spatial and temporal variation in the regulations' implementation to show that federal gasoline standards, which allow refiners flexibility in choosing a compliance mechanism, did not improve air quality. This outcome occurred because minimizing the cost of compliance does not reduce emissions of those compounds most prone to forming ozone. In California, however, we find that precisely targeted, inflexible regulations requiring the removal of particularly harmful compounds significantly improved air quality. (JEL L51, L71, L78, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国汽油成分规制是否成功降低了臭氧污染。这些规制给消费者带来了可观的成本。我们利用规制实施在空间和时间上的差异表明，允许炼油商灵活选择合规机制的联邦汽油标准，并未改善空气质量。之所以出现这一结果，是因为使合规成本最小化，并不能减少那些最易形成臭氧的化合物的排放。然而，在加利福尼亚州，我们发现，精准针对、要求去除特别有害化合物的刚性规制显著改善了空气质量。（JEL L51, L71, L78, Q53, Q58）

title: Grand Challenges for Life-Cycle Assessment of Biofuels

Rice yields in tropical/subtropical Asia exhibit large but opposing sensitivities to minimum and maximum temperatures
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Data from farmer-managed fields have not been used previously to disentangle the impacts of daily minimum and maximum temperatures and solar radiation on rice yields in tropical/subtropical Asia. We used a multiple regression model to analyze data from 227 intensively managed irrigated rice farms in six important rice-producing countries. The farm-level detail, observed over multiple growing seasons, enabled us to construct farm-specific weather variables, control for unobserved factors that either were unique to each farm but did not vary over time or were common to all farms at a given site but varied by season and year, and obtain more precise estimates by including farm- and site-specific economic variables. Temperature and radiation had statistically significant impacts during both the vegetative and ripening phases of the rice plant. Higher minimum temperature reduced yield, whereas higher maximum temperature raised it; radiation impact varied by growth phase. Combined, these effects imply that yield at most sites would have grown more rapidly during the high-yielding season but less rapidly during the low-yielding season if observed temperature and radiation trends at the end of the 20th century had not occurred, with temperature trends being more influential. Looking ahead, they imply a net negative impact on yield from moderate warming in coming decades. Beyond that, the impact would likely become more negative, because prior research indicates that the impact of maximum temperature becomes negative at higher levels. Diurnal temperature variation must be considered when investigating the impacts of climate change on irrigated rice in Asia.
abstract_zh: 此前从未有研究利用农户管理田块的数据，来厘清日最低温、日最高温和太阳辐射对热带及亚热带亚洲水稻产量的不同影响。我们使用多元回归模型，分析了六个主要水稻生产国227个集约化管理灌溉稻田的数据。这些农场层面的详细信息，来自多个生长季的观测，使我们能够构造农场特定的天气变量，控制那些仅为各农场独有但不随时间变化的不可观测因素，或在某一地点所有农场共有但随季节和年份变化的不可观测因素，并通过纳入农场和地点特定的经济变量获得更精确的估计。气温和辐射在水稻植株的营养生长期和灌浆成熟期均产生了统计上显著的影响。较高的最低气温降低产量，而较高的最高气温则提高产量；辐射的影响因生长阶段而异。综合来看，这些效应意味着：若20世纪末观测到的气温和辐射趋势未曾发生，大多数地点的产量在高产季节会增长得更快，而在低产季节则增长得更慢，其中气温趋势的影响更大。展望未来，这些效应意味着未来几十年中等程度的变暖将对产量产生净负面影响。此后，影响可能会变得更为负面，因为已有研究表明，最高气温达到较高水平时，其影响将转为负值。在研究气候变化对亚洲灌溉水稻的影响时，必须考虑昼夜温差。

title: The State of Environmental And Resource Economics: A Google Scholar Perspective
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Until recently, ISI Thompson's Web of Science/Social Sciences Citation Index was the only rigorous tool for tracking citation counts of academic research papers. The recent emergence of Google Scholar provides an alternative measure for tracking citation counts for refereed journal articles, conference proceedings, working papers, and government reports. This article provides an overview of the state of environmental and resource economics using the Google Scholar measure of citations. It ranks and compares the major field journals, and the most cited papers in these journals, the most cited papers in the field that have been published in general economics journals, and the most cited technical books and textbooks, as well as the most cited researchers in the field.
abstract_zh: 在此之前，ISI汤森路透的Web of Science/社会科学引文索引（SSCI）一直是追踪学术论文被引次数的唯一严谨工具。近年来，谷歌学术（Google Scholar）的出现为追踪同行评议期刊论文、会议论文集、工作论文和政府报告的被引次数提供了另一种衡量方式。本文利用谷歌学术的被引次数指标，概述了环境与资源经济学的发展状况。文章对主要专业期刊及其中被引最多的论文进行了排名和比较，同时比较了发表在综合性经济学期刊上的该领域被引最多的论文、被引最多的技术专著和教科书，以及被引最多的研究者。

title: Demand Side Management and Energy Efficiency Revisited
abstract: The key finding of Loughran and Kulick (2004) is that utilities have been overstating electricity savings and underestimating costs associated with energy efficiency demand-side management (DSM) programs. This claim is based on point estimates of average DSM-related savings and costs implied by an econometric model of residential electricity demand. We first argue that the chosen test statistics bias results in favor of rejecting the null hypothesis that utility-reported savings reflect true values. We also note that utility estimates of average program savings and costs are rejected based on point estimates alone. We use the same data and econometric model to estimate the appropriate test statistics. We then construct nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals. These intervals are quite large; we fail to reject the average electricity savings and DSM costs reported by utilities. Our results suggest that the evidence for rejecting utility estimates of DSM savings and costs should be re-interpreted.
abstract_zh: Loughran和Kulick（2004）的主要发现是，公用事业公司高估了能效需求侧管理（DSM）项目的节电量，并低估了相关成本。这一结论基于一个居民电力需求计量模型所隐含的、DSM相关平均节电量和成本的点估计。我们首先指出，所选用的检验统计量存在偏误，使结果偏向于拒绝公用事业公司所报告的节电量反映真实值的原假设。我们还指出，仅凭点估计即否定公用事业公司对项目平均节电量和成本的估计，是不恰当的。我们使用相同的数据和计量模型，估计了恰当的检验统计量。随后，我们构造了非参数自助法（bootstrap）置信区间。这些置信区间相当宽，我们无法拒绝公用事业公司所报告的平均节电量和DSM成本。我们的结果表明，否定公用事业公司DSM节电量和成本估计的证据，应当重新加以解释。

title: The Future Trajectory of US CO2 Emissions: The Role of State vs. Aggregate Information
abstract: This paper provides comparisons of a variety of time‐series methods for short‐run forecasts of the main greenhouse gas, carbon dioxide, for the United States, using a recently released state‐level data set from 1960–2001. We test the out‐of‐sample performance of univariate and multivariate forecasting models by aggregating state‐level forecasts versus forecasting the aggregate directly. We find evidence that forecasting the disaggregate series and accounting for spatial effects drastically improves forecasting performance under root mean squared forecast error loss. Based on the in‐sample observations we attempt to explain the emergence of voluntary efforts by states to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. We find evidence that states with decreasing per capita emissions and a “greener” median voter are more likely to push toward voluntary cutbacks in emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文比较了多种时间序列方法在美国主要温室气体二氧化碳短期预测中的表现，所用数据为近期发布的1960–2001年州级数据集。我们通过对州级预测进行加总，与直接预测总量的结果进行比较，检验了单变量和多变量预测模型的样本外表现。我们发现，在均方根预测误差损失下，对分项序列进行预测并考虑空间效应，可以显著提高预测表现。基于样本内观测，我们试图解释各州自愿减少温室气体排放努力的出现。我们发现，人均排放下降且中位选民更加“绿色”的州，更有可能推动自愿减排。

Integrated model shows that atmospheric brown clouds and greenhouse gases have reduced rice harvests in India
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Previous studies have found that atmospheric brown clouds partially offset the warming effects of greenhouse gases. This finding suggests a tradeoff between the impacts of reducing emissions of aerosols and greenhouse gases. Results from a statistical model of historical rice harvests in India, coupled with regional climate scenarios from a parallel climate model, indicate that joint reductions in brown clouds and greenhouse gases would in fact have complementary, positive impacts on harvests. The results also imply that adverse climate changes due to brown clouds and greenhouse gases contributed to the slowdown in harvest growth that occurred during the past two decades.
abstract_zh: 以往研究发现，大气棕色云层会部分抵消温室气体的增温效应。这一发现意味着减少气溶胶排放与减少温室气体排放的影响之间存在权衡。将印度历史稻谷产量的统计模型，与一个并行气候模式给出的区域气候情景相结合，结果表明，同时减少棕色云层和温室气体，实际上会对稻谷产量产生互补性的正面影响。结果还表明，棕色云层和温室气体导致的不利气候变化，是过去二十年稻谷产量增长放缓的原因之一。
